Author: Glamour Pact contributors
Name: Glamour Pact
Punchline: Dom-controlled looks, local Synced Mods and opt-in strict controls.
Description: An opt-in Dom/Sub outfit library with named outfits, copyable macros, configurable glam locks, local Synced Looks and Customize+ profile/template choices. Shared Customize+ profiles require separate consent. Automatic styling pauses safely during transfers; helmet controls never edit weapons. Optional exact-Dom follow, looping pose locks and GPact Offline control; disabling the plugin remains the local exit. Both players must update to 0.6.1 for new wardrobe controls.
Changelog: Adds default-off shared Customize+ profile permission, including Any World; enable it in My Safety while Offline alongside normal Customize+ consent. Only profiles applying to the Sub are controllable; normal profile/template flags also affect their other assignments/default uses. Outfits can now keep template choices unchanged or save an exact enabled subset, including none. Discovery is explicit and metadata-only; stale template selections fail closed. Recovery preserves manual changes and reassignment. No profile clones, temporary Customize+ overrides or body uploads. Automatic styling pauses during transfers, cleanup and settling, cancels stale sends and resumes without an immediate echo. Auto Send preference, manual Off and existing lock/mirror guards are preserved. Both players must update to 0.6.1.
